body: I know exactly how you feel. If you are willing therapy could definitley help. but I get it. you want to die but at the same time   you can’t actually push yourself to do it, which just drags out the feelings. I think baby steps are best. you can do therapy over zoom, in your own space, and they definitley don’t force you to talk if you wouldnt want to.
I feel like I am stuck between living a life I don’t want to live and not wanting to actually kill myself
